summary: We have developed a prototype game aimed at a younger audience with interests in astronomy. It is based in C++ so if given the opportunity we could further develop it in Unity into a more advanced 3D exploration game. We have also done a bit of research relating to the artificial objects that are located on both The Moon and Mars as shown in our presentation. Alongside this we have also developed in part another prototype aimed at slightly older audiences. This was done using Python. All code will be located on the GitHub repository. Using this game we hope to engage more people at a younger age, fostering a lifelong interest in space and astronomy.
details: Our project is composed of two text based games (one in C++ and one in Python). They are intended for slightly younger audiences (4-8 and 8-12 respectively). If given the opportunity to, we would like to expand upon them but due to the time given we have decided to keep them relatively concise.
